en-US.name: UhWhat? Voice Notes
en-US.subtitle: Capture thoughts in one tap
en-US.promo: Catch a thought before it disappears. Record instantly on iPhone or Apple Watch, then listen, transcribe and organize your notes privately.
en-US.description:
Catch the thought before it disappears.

UhWhat? is a fast, private voice recorder for ideas, reminders and little thoughts that cannot wait. One tap, start speaking, save. Listen and organize later.

QUICK CAPTURE ON IPHONE
Open the app, tap the large microphone button and speak. Tap Stop and save when finished. Your original audio stays on your iPhone, even if transcription is unavailable.

APPLE WATCH CAPTURE
Add the UhWhat? complication to a supported watch face and tap it to open the recorder. Record without carrying your iPhone. Notes are kept locally on the watch until they can be delivered to the paired iPhone. Transfers can take longer when your devices are offline.

YOUR NOTES, YOUR WAY
• Play back the original audio whenever you need it.
• Transcribe speech on-device in a supported language (optional permission and language availability required).
• Edit and correct transcripts without changing the recording.
• Browse the inbox by date, search saved transcripts and archive notes.
• Export your audio (.m4a), transcript (.txt), or both using the iOS share sheet.
• Start a recording from an iPhone Home Screen or Lock Screen widget.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, and no developer cloud storing your voice notes. Your original audio and saved text stay on your own devices. Sharing is always initiated by you.

UhWhat? works as a stand-alone iPhone app; an Apple Watch is optional.

Made by Arvectum. Catch it now. Remember it later.

ru.name: Ухват: голосовые заметки
ru.subtitle: Запись мыслей в одно касание
ru.promo: Мысль пришла — ухвати! Мгновенная запись на iPhone или Apple Watch, прослушивание, расшифровка и порядок в заметках. Без регистрации и облака разработчика.
ru.description:
Мысль пришла — ухвати, пока не забыл!

«Ухват» — простой и приватный диктофон для идей, планов, напоминаний и внезапных мыслей. Одно нажатие — и можно говорить. Разберёшь запись позже.

ЗАПИСЬ ЗА ОДНО НАЖАТИЕ
Открой «Ухват» на iPhone, нажми большую кнопку и начни говорить. Закончил — нажми «Стоп и сохранить». Оригинальная аудиозапись останется на телефоне, даже если расшифровка не удалась.

ЗАПИСЬ С APPLE WATCH
Добавь усложнение «Ухват» на совместимый циферблат. Нажми, чтобы открыть запись прямо на часах — iPhone не нужно доставать. Аудио сохраняется на Apple Watch до подтверждённой передачи на iPhone. Если связи нет, синхронизация произойдёт позднее.

ВСЁ НУЖНОЕ ДЛЯ ЗАМЕТОК
• Слушай оригинальное аудио в любое время.
• Расшифровывай речь непосредственно на устройстве, когда язык поддерживается системой (нужно отдельное разрешение).
• Исправляй текст вручную — аудио не меняется.
• Смотри записи по датам, ищи по сохранённым расшифровкам, перемещай в архив.
• Отправляй аудио (.m4a), текст (.txt) или оба файла через системное меню «Поделиться».
• Запускай запись с виджета iPhone.

ЛИЧНОЕ ОСТАЁТСЯ ЛИЧНЫМ
Никакой регистрации, рекламы, отслеживания действий и облачного сервера разработчика для хранения записей. Аудио и тексты остаются на твоих устройствах. Экспортируешь их только ты сам.

«Ухват» работает и без Apple Watch — достаточно iPhone.

Сделано в Арвектуме. Ухвати сейчас — вспомни потом.

appReviewNotes:
REVIEW GUIDE — UhWhat? / Ухват, v1.0.0 (5)

UhWhat? is a private, local-first voice capture utility, not a messaging app. It requires NO account, login, subscription, backend or test credentials. Every feature described below can be tested with a short disposable voice recording.

iPHONE (fully functional without Apple Watch)
1. Open UhWhat? and tap the large mint recording button.
2. Allow microphone permission on first use. Speak a short sentence; tap “Stop and save”.
3. Open “My recordings” to find the new note. Tap Play to hear the ORIGINAL .m4a.
4. Tap Transcribe and optionally grant Speech Recognition access; transcription uses the on-device recognizer when it supports the selected language. Speech recognition availability varies with iOS language assets. If no model is available, the source audio is still saved and plays normally.
5. Tap Edit text to edit a saved transcript, use Search to find text, swipe or use More to archive, and use Export to share audio (.m4a), transcript (.txt), or both. Delete requires confirmation.

APPLE WATCH (optional)
1. Open the bundled Apple Watch app, grant microphone access, and record a short thought; tap Stop.
2. Optionally add the UhWhat? complication to the watch face. Tapping it launches the Watch app and starts capture as soon as permissions and the audio session allow it.
3. Watch audio is durably queued on the Watch and sent to the paired iPhone by WatchConnectivity; it remains on the Watch until the iPhone acknowledges safe storage. Transfer is opportunistic and may be delayed when offline or during background execution. Check the iPhone recordings list after reconnection.

The iPhone recording widget is a launcher: it opens the app directly to capture, because iOS does not permit a regular WidgetKit extension to use the microphone in the background.

PRIVACY: Notes stay on the owner's iPhone/Watch, are not uploaded to Arvectum servers and are not used for analytics or advertising. No user account or external service is required for capturing audio. All requested permissions are contextual. Reviewer can safely make/delete disposable demo notes.

SCREEN RECORDING (27 seconds, synthetic in-app data only): https://arvectum.com/tools/what/review/index.html
Direct MP4: https://arvectum.com/assets/apps/what/review-demo-1.0.0.mp4
